column3: field 0 means the whole database in AOO (legacy); Part 4 4.11.10 wants an error

column3: AOO ignores empty criteria cells; Part 4 4.11.11 reads an empty criterion as the number 0

column1: test_formula_result[DCOUNTA.emptycrit]
column3: AOO ignores empty criteria cells; Part 4 4.11.11 reads an empty criterion as the number 0

column1: test_formula_result[CONVERT.atm]
column3: AOO's standard atmosphere is 101324.996583 Pa; the ODF 1.4 Part 4 table gives 1.0132510E+5 (a relative difference of 1.0e-6)

column1: test_formula_result[NPER.empty]
column3: the formula compiler rejects an empty last parameter before ')' (Err:511) for every function except IF; an empty parameter in the middle works

column1: test_formula_result[INDEX.row.rowonly]
column3: INDEX on a row vector with only a row argument returns the column (Excel behaviour); ODF 1.4 calls it an error
